verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents official SDKs for application code, including the `openai` npm package and the Agents SDK for orchestration. The official openai-python GitHub repo confirms a maintained Python library for the REST API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and documentation of the full set of supported languages beyond Node and Python.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: official SDKs for application code, the OpenAI CLI for shell-native workflows, the Agents SDK for orchestration, or your own preferred HTTP client
